justification: Two display fixes for the Intelligence Brief. (1) satellite.terrain was missing from EXPECTED_SECTIONS_SAT, so although the backend always emits the terrain section, it never appeared in the live progress checklist — the user couldn't see that terrain ran (or was pending). Added it. (2) Added plain-English descriptions (FIELD_HINTS + a FieldLabel component) under opaque satellite/flood/neighbourhood field labels (JRC occurrence %, WOfS frequency %, BoM gauge distance, flood studies, EPI flood, nearby DAs, DA count) so a dash or a bare number now has meaning. Display-only; no logic, query, or schema change.

pre_impl.existing_data: EXPECTED_SECTIONS_SAT drove the live progress checklist; the card-render dispatch (sectionEvents.map) was never filtered by it, so terrain still rendered when its section arrived — only the checklist omitted it. Field labels came from formatKey(key) with no descriptions.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: Assumed terrain was dropped entirely; in fact only the checklist omitted it, and on DEM failure terrain falls through to a generic 'unavailable' card (the missing terrain *diagram* is a separate DEM-fetch issue, not this change).
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Reused formatKey + the existing dt/dd field layout; added a FieldLabel wrapper and a FIELD_HINTS lookup. No new data source.
pre_impl.user_failure_mode: Before: terrain absent from the progress list; flood/neighbourhood fields showed acronyms or bare numbers with no explanation. After: terrain is listed; each opaque field carries a one-line plain-English description.

functions.name: FieldLabel
functions.output: the humanised label plus, when present, a muted one-line description from FIELD_HINTS
functions.if_none: fields without a hint render exactly as before — just the label

values: N/A - display only; no regulatory values.
queries: N/A - no database or API query.

break_it.scenario: A field key collides with a FIELD_HINTS entry but appears in a section where the hint is misleading
break_it.repro: the hint keys (jrc_occurrence_pct, wofs_frequency_pct, bom_gauge_distance_km, flood_studies, epi_flood, flood_epi, nearby_das, da_count) are specific enough that no other field reuses them
break_it.how: keys are exact field names unique to the flood and neighbourhood sections

break_it.scenario: Adding terrain to EXPECTED_SECTIONS_SAT double-renders the terrain card
break_it.repro: the expected list only feeds the progress checklist, not the card dispatch, which renders one card per received section event
break_it.how: card rendering iterates sectionEvents (one per emitted section), independent of the expected list

break_it.scenario: The hint line overflows or breaks the two-column field grid on mobile
break_it.what_happens: the hint line could overflow the field cell and shift the two-column grid
break_it.repro: the hint is a block span with small text inside the existing flex-col cell
break_it.how: rendered as a block child of the existing dt cell with leading-snug; the grid cell already wraps

post_merge.manual_verify: Run a brief with satellite on: 'Terrain Analysis' now appears in the live progress checklist; the Flood and Neighbourhood cards show a one-line description under each field (JRC/WOfS/gauge/flood-studies/EPI flood/nearby DAs).
